summary: Table.search(cond, limit=None): cached results are returned sliced to limit; on a cache miss the table is scanned in ID order and the scan stops once limit matches are collected. The existing is_cacheable() handling after the scan is unchanged. No change in database.py (search is forwarded by __getattr__).
